CHAPTER.VERS: I lifted up my eyes, and saw, and behold, a man with a measuring line in his hand.
Then I asked, "Where are you going?"
Behold, the angel who talked with me went forth, and another angel went out to meet him,
and said to him, "Run, speak to this young man, saying, 'Jerusalem will be inhabited as villages without walls, because of the multitude of men and livestock in it.
For I,' says , 'will be to her a wall of fire around it, and I will be the glory in the midst of her.
Come! Come! Flee from the land of the north,' says ; 'for I have spread you abroad as the four winds of the sky,' says .
'Come, Zion! Escape, you who dwell with the daughter of Babylon.'
For thus says of hosts: 'For honor he has sent me to the nations which plundered you; for he who touches you touches the apple of his eye.
For, behold, I will shake my hand over them, and they will be a spoil to those who served them; and you will know that of hosts has sent me.
Sing and rejoice, daughter of Zion; for, behold, I come, and I will dwell in the midst of you,' says .
Many nations shall join themselves to in that day, and shall be my people; and I will dwell in the midst of you, and you shall know that of hosts has sent me to you.
will inherit Judah as his portion in the holy land, and will again choose Jerusalem.
Be silent, all flesh, before ; for he has roused himself from his holy habitation!"
